exposure: baseline serum b-human chorionic gonadotropin (b-hCG) levels
time interval between methotrexate (MTX) and surgery
presence of positive fetal heart activity before surgery
outcome: failure of initial combined local methotrexate (MTX) treatment and minimally invasive surgery for late cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: The study included 574 patients diagnosed with late cesarean scar pregnancy (>= 8 weeks) who received local methotrexate injection combined with minimally invasive surgery between January 2016 and December 2023.
finding: Higher baseline serum b-hCG levels (exceeding 94,000 IU/L), an extended time interval (greater than seven days) between MTX and surgery, type III CSP, and a positive preoperative fetal heartbeat were identified as independent risk factors for the failure of initial combined treatment for late CSP.
